Aria S: Kicking off the remediation sprint from the postmortem. Short list of owners + dates so we can close before the rehearsal.
Leo H: Paste the owner matrix pls.
Aria S: Items: (A) Routing cutover rehearsal + comms script (owner: Leo, due 2026-04-11), (B) End-to-end restore runbook w/ explicit approval & rollback steps (owner: Maya, due 2026-04-06), (C) Snapshot audit + restore timing samples (owner: Maya, due 2026-04-08), (D) Cache-priming traffic replay added to playbook (owner: Leo, due 2026-04-11), (E) Hook up preflight health checks & SLI tracking (owner: Platform Eng, due 2026-04-15).
Maya R: I'll take runbook and snapshot audit. Plan: CSV of retention + sample restores, mark any >45m and propose retention fixes.
Leo H: For routing rehearsal I want a non-disruptive withdraw on a test prefix and a manual warm-standby promotion for first two rehearsals. I'll draft the cutover and comms checklist.
Aria S: ops-bot, please create an epic and schedule a rehearsal window late March.
ops-bot: jira: created epic RI-3333 "DR remediation sprint". tickets created: RI-3334..RI-3338. scheduled: "DR rehearsal - routing & restores" 2026-03-30 23:00 UTC.
Maya R: Noted repeated pattern: cache cold-start causing latency after failover. I'll add post-restore cache validation and a small replay to pre-seed.
Leo H: Agree. Also add DNS propagation checks across regions after failback.
Aria S: Closure acceptance: runbook merged, snapshot audit posted, rehearsal scheduled and executed, preflight hooks wired, SLI set (restore <=45m p90). Reconvene 2026-04-12 for final signoff. :calendar: 
Maya R: ACK, will post CSV and runbook link to RI-3333.
Leo H: ACK, will post rehearsal plan and comms draft.
Aria S: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
